decision_basis: Section-26 causal reference-use gate FAIL (REFERENCE_ADAPTER_IGNORED) on DEV, confirmed by held-out song-disjoint documentation test on 5 recordings / 20 windows. Human listening NOT warranted (section 30 gate condition 3 fails: 'correct reference demonstrably matters' is false).

reference_corpus.dev: 3 recordings / 3 songs (2 promoted from TRAIN, documented)
reference_corpus.test: 5 recordings / 5 songs, all song-disjoint from TRAIN
reference_corpus.alignment: production hybrid path; 24/31 candidate pairs accepted; residuals <= 0.05 s; 7 rejected conservatively (incl. the sealed recording's only candidate reference)

adapter.architecture: minimal TF-domain CNN (12k params) on standardized mix+ref log-magnitude, zero-init output head as section-15 residual gate, fused at S1R mask logits; trainable = adapter + final mask head = 15.49M params (4.85%)
adapter.initialization_parity: EXACT (max|delta| = 0.0 vs S1R for correct/zero/wrong refs)

training.run_1: INVALIDATED by reference-position sign bug (t_ref = t_hand + offset); internally consistent but ~20s misaligned conditioning; recorded in FAILURE_CASES section 2
training.run_2: corrected pipeline, identical declared hyperparameters: 1500 updates, AdamW lr 2e-5, alpha U[0.12,0.45], seed 20260915, 4049 s wall, 4.96 GB peak VRAM, no guards tripped
training.signals: S1R anchor + injection invariance + cross-context consistency + anti-collapse + L2-SP (section 20 A-D)

causal_reference_evidence.dev_best: suppression advantage vs S1R +0.0074 dB; correct-vs-zero gap 0.0012 dB; correct-vs-wrong gap 0.0002 dB (section-25 gate requires >= 1.0 dB: FAIL at every checkpoint)
causal_reference_evidence.heldout: median suppression advantage vs S1R +0.013 dB (max +0.027; 0/20 windows >= 1.5 dB); correct-vs-wrong median gap 0.000 dB
causal_reference_evidence.conclusion: correct, wrong, and zero references are effectively identical - the adapter does not use reference content

safety.collapse: zero at every DEV eval and every held-out window
safety.wrong_reference: safe (median ratio -0.27 dB vs S1R target; no suppression triggered)
safety.transient_retention: identical to S1R (median -0.386 dB vs -0.386 dB on held-out)

why_C_and_not_B: B requires the adapter to demonstrably USE the correct reference with real but unclear product gain. Here the adapter uses NO reference content at all: correct/wrong/zero are indistinguishable. This is the section-26 stop condition REFERENCE_ADAPTER_IGNORED, classified C under section 36 ('correct reference is no better than wrong reference').
why_C_and_not_D: The experiment is scientifically valid: data gate PASS (preferred minimums), production alignment with conservative acceptance, exact initialization parity, both training runs completed without guards, all safety metrics clean, held-out documentation test executed under a frozen protocol. The negative is trustworthy.
stage_should_not_continue_with: more training of the same adapter/objective (structural: the section-20 anchor pins clean behavior to the teacher, leaving ~0.01 L1 of learnable margin, whose cheapest explanation is reference presence, not content)
human listening for this stage (machine gate failed; nothing audible to compare)
what_would_be_needed_for_a_future_attemp: an objective that directly rewards reference-CONTENT-specific suppression (e.g., paired correct-vs-wrong contrastive terms), not merely invariance to injected nuisance
accepting a larger trainable surface with correspondingly stronger anchor machinery
these are recorded as hypotheses, NOT recommendations to start
